install.question: How do I install Chrome extensions?
install.answer: Simply click the 'Add to Chrome' button on any extension page. Chrome will prompt you to confirm the installation. Once confirmed, the extension will be added to your browser automatically.

free.question: Are these extensions free to use?
free.answer: Yes. All ExtensionTo extensions are free — every 'Add to Chrome' button installs the complete extension at no cost.

manage.question: How do I manage or remove extensions?
manage.answer: Click the puzzle piece icon in Chrome's toolbar to see all installed extensions. You can pin, disable, or remove any extension from there. Alternatively, visit chrome://extensions in your browser.

safe.question: Is my data safe with these extensions?
safe.answer: Every extension links to its official Chrome Web Store listing, where you can review the permissions it requests before you install.

speed.question: Do extensions slow down my browser?
speed.answer: If an extension isn't needed, you can disable or remove it at any time from chrome://extensions in your browser.

support.question: How do I get support for an extension?
support.answer: You can reach the team through the contact form on this website, or leave a review on the Chrome Web Store.
